about: Replies that wait on a code, text, email or prompt the person just said never reached them, instead of taking another route. From the 2026-11-04 morning chat and the 2026-10-28/29 tester chats.

cases.q: the approval notification never showed up on my phone
cases.reply: Approve the request on your phone and I'll continue.

cases.reply: Send me the 6-digit code when it arrives and I'll finish.
